title: T008 CI pipelines dispatched with runtime proof pending
summary: T008 workflows and Dependabot configuration are implemented on an isolated branch; static proof passes, while GitHub Actions and Docker health remain pending.

claims.text: T008 requires CI, security and Dependabot files under .github.
The implementation uses fixed action commit SHAs, least-privilege permissions and retained reports.
T007 Docker Compose health is not yet proven on GitHub Actions until the workflow runs.
T008 must remain unchecked until runtime evidence is read back.

decision.context: T007 was merged with explicit runtime-proof follow-up assigned to T008.
decision.chosen: Implement and execute T008 through GitHub Actions before changing the T008 checkbox or merge state.
alternatives: Mark T008 complete from static inspection only
tradeoffs: Runtime evidence is delayed until remote runners execute
No unchecked task is represented as complete
decision.invalidation: If workflows cannot run or fail the dependency health proof, keep T008 unchecked and record the failing receipt.
